items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Binnen zwei Wochen nach der Zustellung dieses Bescheids kann Einspruch eingelegt werden, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Stadt Musterhomburg (Saar) – Ordnungsbehörde.
items.computation: This is a formally served notice (Postzustellungsurkunde, § 182 ZPO) — the statutory 'deemed delivery' fiction for ordinary authority post does not apply; the date actually marked on the Zustellungsurkunde governs. The attached envelope scan shows 'zugestellt am 24.11.2026' (Tuesday). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery itself is not counted, so the two-week period starts 2026-11-25. Two weeks later (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB) is 2026-12-08 (Tuesday), which is a normal working day in Saarland, so no weekend/holiday shift applies (checked against the Saarland 2026 holiday list). The objection must reach the authority by this date.

items.title: Pay the total fine (Geldbuße, Gebühr, Auslagen) after the notice becomes final
items.quote: Bitte überweisen Sie den Gesamtbetrag erst nach Rechtskraft, und zwar innerhalb von zwei Wochen.
items.computation: The letter instructs payment only after Rechtskraft (the notice becoming final) and 'danach wird der Bescheid rechtskräftig' refers to the moment the two-week Einspruch period (ending 2026-12-08) expires without an objection being filed. Assuming no Einspruch is lodged, Rechtskraft occurs the following day, 2026-12-09 (Wednesday). Applying § 187 Abs. 1 BGB (the day of the triggering event is not counted) the two-week payment period starts 2026-12-10 and ends, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, on 2026-12-23 (Wednesday) — a normal working day in Saarland, so no shift is needed. This date only applies if no Einspruch is filed by 2026-12-08; filing an objection suspends both Rechtskraft and the payment obligation.

warnings: The Einspruch and payment deadlines both depend on the delivery date handwritten on the attached envelope scan ('zugestellt 24.11.2026'); verify that date against the actual Zustellungsurkunde/envelope you received, since a different delivery date would shift both deadlines.

Do not pay before the notice is final (Rechtskraft) as the letter itself warns — paying early could be read as accepting the fine and forfeiting the right to object; file any Einspruch first if you intend to dispute it.
The payment deadline given here (2026-12-23) only holds if no Einspruch is filed by 2026-12-08; filing an objection changes the timeline entirely.

The IBAN DE86 5945 0010 0004 2401 00 is a validly formatted German IBAN, but as with any payment instruction, confirm the payee name shown by your bank's mandatory account-name check before transferring money.
